#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -o pipefail
ROOT=/mnt/data/work/t3_chatgpt_agent_build_workspace_v2
SRC=$ROOT/source/primary
LOG=$ROOT/artifacts/baseline/02-pnpm-install-internal.log
cd "$SRC"
export PATH="$ROOT/.tools/node24/bin:$PATH"
export npm_config_registry="$NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY"
echo started_at=$(date -Iseconds) > "$LOG"
/usr/bin/time -v "$ROOT/.tools/node24/bin/node" "$ROOT/.tools/pnpm11/bin/pnpm.cjs" install --frozen-lockfile --registry="$NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
rc=$?
echo exit_code=$rc finished_at=$(date -Iseconds) >> "$LOG"
echo $rc > "$ROOT/artifacts/baseline/02-pnpm-install-internal.exit"
